[May 28th, 2026 11:30 PM] scott.slover: Congrats to <@U091RALD60J> for a quick AI WIN with CultureFly!! :tada:
In under 2 months, we closed a 2-year deal worth $100K TCV covering 70K conversations/year. The use case is tier-1 email deflection through Zendesk for their CS team.

We beat out Calvary because of the overall trust and confidence our champion had in us, explicitly saying, “I feel confident, I think you guys have it under control.”

This speaks to a well-run sales process led by Ali, with incredible support from <@U09RGBE29T9> who built and delivered a kick-ass custom demo showcasing our Zendesk integration and a must-have Shopify “integration” (which took some creativity by building a working mock integration :muscle:).  This will unlock other deals that use Shopify once CultureFly is up and running! :raised_hands:

Great win and an awesome example of how strong execution, creativity, and customer trust drive results. :rocket:
